description:
Attach an existing Repomix packed output file for AI analysis.
This tool accepts either a directory containing a repomix output file or a direct path to a packed repository file.
Supports multiple formats: XML (structured with <file> tags), Markdown (human-readable with ## headers and code blocks), JSON (machine-readable with files as key-value pairs), and Plain text (simple format with separators).
Calling the tool again with the same file path will refresh the content if the file has been updated.
It will return in that case a new output ID and the updated content.

path.description: Path to a directory containing repomix output file or direct path to a packed repository file (supports .xml, .md, .txt, .json formats)

topFilesLength.description: Number of largest files by size to display in the metrics summary (default: 10)

name: attach_packed_output

description.description: Human-readable description of the attached output

directoryStructure.description: Tree structure extracted from the packed output

outputFilePath.description: File path to the attached output file

outputId.description: Unique identifier for accessing the packed content

result.description: JSON string containing detailed metrics and file information

totalFiles.description: Total number of files in the packed output

totalTokens.description: Total token count of the content

title: Attach Packed Output
